<!DOCTYPE html>

    <style>
        :root {

<body>

    <header>
        <div class="logo-area">
            <img class="brand-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="GEM Travel Agencies logo">
            <div class="logo-text">
                <h1>GEM TRAVEL</h1>
                <p id="header-subtitle">Travel Agencies - Explore Egypt</p>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="lang-selector">
            <select id="languageSelect" onchange="changeLanguage(this.value)">
                <option value="ar">العربية</option>
                <option value="en" selected>English</option>
                <option value="fr">Français</option>
                <option value="es">Español</option>
                <option value="zh">中文</option>
                <option value="ja">日本語</option>
            </select>
        </div>
    </header>

    <div class="container">
        <!-- الصفحة الرئيسية للخدمات -->
        <div id="main-hub-screen">
            <section class="welcome-hero">
                <span class="hero-kicker">GEM TRAVEL AGENCIES</span>
                <h2 id="hero-title">Discover Egypt, beautifully</h2>
                <p id="hero-desc">Thoughtfully planned tours, comfortable transfers, and memorable experiences across Egypt.</p>
                <div class="hero-tags"><span>Private Tours</span><span>Comfortable Transfers</span><span>Local Experience</span></div>
            </section>
            <div class="section-title" id="txt-main-title">Welcome to Gem Travel - Select Service</div>
            <div class="main-menu-grid">
                <div class="main-btn" onclick="openScreen('sightseeing-screen')" id="btn-sightseeing">🏛️ Sightseeing & Excursions</div>
                <div class="main-btn" onclick="openScreen('car-rental-screen')" id="btn-car-rental">🚗 Car Rental with Driver</div>
                <div class="main-btn" onclick="openScreen('airport-transfer-screen')" id="btn-airport-transfer">✈️ Airport Transfer</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- شاشة المحافظات (Sightseeing) -->
        <div id="sightseeing-screen" class="hidden">
            <button class="back-btn" id="btn-back-main1" onclick="goMainHub()">← Main Menu</button>
            <div class="section-title" id="txt-choose-gov">Select Destination</div>
            <div class="grid">
                <div class="btn-card" onclick="openGov('Cairo')">Cairo (القاهرة)</div>
                <div class="btn-card" onclick="openGov('Alex')">Alexandria (الإسكندرية)</div>
                <div class="btn-card" onclick="openGov('Aswan')">Aswan (أسوان)</div>
                <div class="btn-card" onclick="openGov('Luxor')">Luxor (الأقصر)</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- شاشة تأجير السيارات -->
        <div id="car-rental-screen" class="hidden">
            <button class="back-btn" id="btn-back-main2" onclick="goMainHub()">← Main Menu</button>
            <div class="info-card">
                <h3 id="car-title">🚗 Car Rental with Professional Driver</h3>
                <p id="car-desc">
                    استمتع براحة الحرية والاستكشاف على طريقتك الخاصة! نوفر لك سيارات حديثة ومكيفة بالكامل مع نخبة من السائقين المحترفين الذين يجيدون القيادة بأمان تام ومعرفة واسعة بكل الطرق والمعالم السياحية. سواء كنت ترغب في جولة داخل المدينة أو سفر بين المحافظات، وفرنا لك الخيار الأمثل لتستمتع برحلتك دون القلق من الزحام أو الاتجاهات.
                </p>
            </div>
            <div class="whatsapp-box">
                <a id="wa-car-link" href="#" target="_blank" class="whatsapp-btn">
                    💬 Book Car & Driver via WhatsApp
                </a>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- شاشة انتقالات المطار -->
        <div id="airport-transfer-screen" class="hidden">
            <button class="back-btn" id="btn-back-main3" onclick="goMainHub()">← Main Menu</button>
            <div class="info-card">
                <h3 id="airport-title">✈️ Seamless Airport Transfers</h3>
                <p id="airport-desc">
                    ابدأ رحلتك بلا أي إرهاق! نحن في انتظارك لحظة هبوط طائرتك. نوفر لك خدمة انتقالات فخمة ومريحة من وإلى المطار، بغض النظر عن حجم عائلتك أو عدد حقائبك؛ لدينا الأسطول المناسب (من سيارات السيدان الفارهة وحتى الفان العائلي الواسع) لضمان وصولك أنت وأمتعتك بكل أمان وراحة إلى وجهتك.
                </p>
            </div>
            <div class="whatsapp-box">
                <a id="wa-airport-link" href="#" target="_blank" class="whatsapp-btn">
                    💬 Book Airport Transfer via WhatsApp
                </a>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- شاشة تفاصيل المحافظة والأماكن -->
        <div id="gov-screen" class="hidden">
            <button class="back-btn" id="btn-back-sightseeing" onclick="openScreen('sightseeing-screen')">← Back to Destinations</button>
            <div id="gov-content"></div>
        </div>

        <!-- شاشة عرض الصور والحجز -->
        <div id="detail-screen" class="hidden">
            <button class="back-btn" id="btn-back-gov" onclick="backToGov()">← Back to Places</button>
            <div class="section-title" id="place-title">Place Details</div>
            
            <div class="slideshow-container" id="slider-container"></div>

            <div class="whatsapp-box">
                <a id="wa-link" href="#" target="_blank" class="whatsapp-btn">
                    💬 Contact for Details & Reservation
                </a>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <footer class="site-footer">
        <div class="footer-brand">GEM TRAVEL <span>AGENCIES</span></div>
        <p>Explore Egypt with comfort, care, and confidence.</p>
        <div class="footer-credit">Designed by <strong>Basel Saeed</strong></div>
    </footer>

    <script>
        // الأرقام المعتمدة للواتساب
        const primaryWhatsApp = "201062519011";
        // Google Drive image index (the original Drive filenames and IDs are never translated or renamed)
        const DRIVE_IMAGES_API = "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwdL02se97JWdLc_cg1ljJ53UCtEazUPMipz8JetzXwd5pqV7fRJHTILvoozatSK_L4Ww/exec";
        let driveImages = [];
        let driveImagesReady = false;

        function normalizeFolderPart(value) {
            return String(value || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
        }

        function imagesForPlace(govKey, placeName) {
            const govFolder = ({ Cairo: 'cairo', Alex: 'alexandria', Aswan: 'aswan', Luxor: 'luxor' })[govKey] || normalizeFolderPart(govKey);
            const target = normalizeFolderPart(placeName);
            return driveImages.filter(file => {
                const parts = String(file.folder || '').split('/').map(normalizeFolderPart);
                const govIndex = parts.findIndex(part => part === govFolder || (govFolder === 'alexandria' && part === 'alex'));
                return govIndex >= 0 && parts.slice(govIndex + 1).some(part => part === target) && /^image\//i.test(file.mimeType || 'image/');
            }).sort((a, b) => String(a.name || '').localeCompare(String(b.name || ''), undefined, { numeric: true }));
        }

        async function loadDriveImages() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(DRIVE_IMAGES_API, { method: 'GET', redirect: 'follow', cache: 'no-store' });
                if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Drive image list request failed: ' + response.status);
                const data = await response.json();
                if (!Array.isArray(data)) throw new Error('The Apps Script response is not a JSON array.');
                driveImages = data.filter(file => file && file.id && file.url && file.name && file.folder);
                driveImagesReady = true;
                refreshDestinationThumbnails();
                console.info('GEM TRAVEL: loaded ' + driveImages.length + ' Drive images.');
            } catch (error) {
                console.warn('GEM TRAVEL could not load the Drive image list. Check Apps Script deployment and sharing.', error);
            }
        }

        function refreshDestinationThumbnails() {
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-gov][data-place]').forEach(card => {
                const matches = imagesForPlace(card.dataset.gov, card.dataset.place);
                if (matches.length) {
                    const img = card.querySelector('.destination-thumb');
                    img.src = matches[0].url;
                    img.alt = matches[0].name; // preserve the exact original filename
                    card.classList.remove('no-photo');
                }
            });
        }

        const translations = {
            ar: {
                subtitle: "اكتشف مصر",
                heroTitle: "اكتشف مصر بأفضل تجربة",
                heroDesc: "رحلات مصممة بعناية، وانتقالات مريحة، وتجارب لا تُنسى في جميع أنحاء مصر.",
                mainTitle: "مرحباً بك في Gem Travel - اختر الخدمة المطلوبة",
                sightseeing: "🏛️ الجولات السياحية والرحلات (Sightseeing & Excursions)",
                carRental: "🚗 تأجير سيارات مع سائق (Car Rental with Driver)",
                airportTransfer: "✈️ انتقالات المطار (Airport Transfers)",
                backMain: "← القائمة الرئيسية",
                backDest: "← العودة للوجهات",

        let currentLang = 'en';

        function changeLanguage(lang) {
            currentLang = lang;
            const t = translations[lang];
            
            const htmlRoot = document.getElementById('html-root');
            if (lang === 'ar') {
                htmlRoot.setAttribute('dir', 'rtl');
                htmlRoot.setAttribute('lang', 'ar');
            } else {
                htmlRoot.setAttribute('dir', 'ltr');
                htmlRoot.setAttribute('lang', lang);
            }

            document.getElementById('header-subtitle').innerText = t.subtitle;
            document.getElementById('hero-title').innerText = t.heroTitle || translations.en.heroTitle;
            document.getElementById('hero-desc').innerText = t.heroDesc || translations.en.heroDesc;
            document.getElementById('txt-main-title').innerText = t.mainTitle;
            document.getElementById('btn-sightseeing').innerText = t.sightseeing;
            document.getElementById('btn-car-rental').innerText = t.carRental;
            document.getElementById('btn-airport-transfer').innerText = t.airportTransfer;
            
            document.getElementById('btn-back-main1').innerText = t.backMain;
            document.getElementById('btn-back-main2').innerText = t.backMain;
            document.getElementById('btn-back-main3').innerText = t.backMain;
            document.getElementById('btn-back-sightseeing').innerText = t.backDest;
            document.getElementById('txt-choose-gov').innerText = t.chooseGov;
            
            document.getElementById('car-title').innerText = t.carTitle;
            document.getElementById('car-desc').innerText = t.carDesc;
            document.getElementById('wa-car-link').innerText = t.carWa;
            
            document.getElementById('airport-title').innerText = t.airportTitle;
            document.getElementById('airport-desc').innerText = t.airportDesc;
            document.getElementById('wa-airport-link').innerText = t.airportWa;

            document.getElementById('wa-car-link').href = `https://wa.me/${primaryWhatsApp}?text=${encodeURIComponent('Hello Gem Travel, I want to inquire about Car Rental with Driver.')}`;
            document.getElementById('wa-airport-link').href = `https://wa.me/${primaryWhatsApp}?text=${encodeURIComponent('Hello Gem Travel, I want to book an Airport Transfer.')}`;

            const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('#sightseeing-screen .btn-card');
            const keys = ['Cairo', 'Alex', 'Aswan', 'Luxor'];
            buttons.forEach((btn, index) => {
                let keyName = keys[index].toLowerCase();
                btn.innerText = t[keyName] || keys[index];
            });
        }

        function openScreen(screenId) {
            document.getElementById('main-hub-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('sightseeing-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('car-rental-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('airport-transfer-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('gov-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('detail-screen').classList.add('hidden');

            document.getElementById(screenId).classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        function goMainHub() {
            openScreen('main-hub-screen');
        }

        // قاعدة بيانات المحافظات والأماكن متوافقة مع تفريعات جهازك

            Cairo: {
                title: { ar: "رحلات القاهرة", en: "Cairo Tours", fr: "Excursions au Caire", es: "Tours por El Cairo", zh: "开罗旅游", ja: "カイロツアー" },
                subsections: [
                    {
                        category: { ar: "رحلات نهارية (Day Trips)", en: "Cairo Day Trips", fr: "Visites diurnes", es: "Tours diurnos", zh: "日间游", ja: "日帰りツアー" },
                        items: [
                            { name: "Pyramids of Giza", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1539650116574-8efeb43e2750", "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1568322445760-727c66798c8c"] },
                            { name: "Cairo Citadel", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1572252009286-268acec5ca0a"] },
                            { name: "Grand Egyptian Museum", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1564507592333-c60657eea523"] },
                            { name: "Saqqara", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1508739773434-c26b3d09e071"] },
                            { name: "Coptic Cairo", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544816155-12df9643f363"] },
                            { name: "Islamic Cairo", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1572252009286-268acec5ca0a"] }
                        ]
                    },
                    {
                        category: { ar: "رحلات ليلية (Night Trips)", en: "Cairo Night Trips", fr: "Visites nocturnes", es: "Tours nocturnos", zh: "夜游", ja: "ナイトツアー" },
                        items: [
                            { name: "Khan El Khalili", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1572252009286-268acec5ca0a"] },
                            { name: "Dinner Cruise", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1518684079-3c830dcef090"] }

                    }
                ]
            },
            Alex: {
                title: { ar: "الإسكندرية", en: "Alexandria", fr: "Alexandrie", es: "Alejandría", zh: "亚历山大", ja: "アレクサンドリア" },
                subsections: [
                    {
                        category: { ar: "معالم الإسكندرية", en: "Alexandria Landmarks", fr: "Monuments", es: "Monumentos", zh: "地标", ja: "ランドマーク" },

                            { name: "Qaitbay Castle", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1568605117036-5fe5e7bab0b7"] },

                        ]
                    }
                ]
            },
            Aswan: {
                title: { ar: "أسوان", en: "Aswan", fr: "Assouan", es: "Asuán", zh: "阿斯旺", ja: "アスワン" },
                subsections: [
                    {
                        category: { ar: "معالم أسوان", en: "Aswan Highlights", fr: "Sites d'Assouan", es: "Sitios de Asuán", zh: "阿斯旺景点", ja: "アスワンの見どころ" },
                        items: [
                            { name: "Abu Simbel", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1564507592333-c60657eea523"] },
                            { name: "Nubian Village", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544816155-12df9643f363"] },
                            { name: "Temple of Kom Ombo", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1608953151270-2495edab4fb6"] },
                            { name: "Temple of Philae", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1564507592333-c60657eea523"] }
                        ]
                    }
                ]
            },
            Luxor: {
                title: { ar: "الأقصر", en: "Luxor", fr: "Louxor", es: "Luxor", zh: "卢克索", ja: "ルクソール" },
                subsections: [
                    {
                        category: { ar: "معالم الأقصر", en: "Luxor Temples & Valley", fr: "Temples de Louxor", es: "Templos de Luxor", zh: "卢克索神庙与河谷", ja: "ルクソールの神殿と渓谷" },
                        items: [
                            { name: "Karnak Temple", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1608953151270-2495edab4fb6"] },
                            { name: "Valley of the Kings", images: ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1568322445760-727c66798c8c"] }
                        ]
                    }
                ]

        function openGov(govKey) {
            document.getElementById('sightseeing-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('gov-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
            
            const data = tourData[govKey];
            let govTitle = data.title[currentLang] || data.title['en'];
            let html = `<div class="section-title">${govTitle}</div>`;
            
            data.subsections.forEach(sub => {
                let catName = sub.category[currentLang] || sub.category['en'];
                if(catName) html += `<h4 style="color:#0284c7; margin-top:20px;">${catName}</h4>`;
                html += `<div class="grid">`;
                sub.items.forEach(item => {
                    const safeName = String(item.name).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
                    const preview = imagesForPlace(govKey, item.name)[0];
                    const previewUrl = preview ? preview.url : (item.images && item.images[0] ? item.images[0] : '');
                    html += `<div class="btn-card destination-card ${previewUrl ? '' : 'no-photo'}" data-gov="${govKey}" data-place="${safeName}" onclick='openPlace(${JSON.stringify(item.name)}, ${JSON.stringify(item.images)}, ${JSON.stringify(govKey)})'>${previewUrl ? `<img class="destination-thumb" src="${previewUrl}" alt="${preview ? preview.name : safeName}" loading="lazy">` : '<img class="destination-thumb" alt="" loading="lazy">'}<span class="destination-name">${safeName}</span></div>`;
                });
                html += `</div>`;
            });
            document.getElementById('gov-content').innerHTML = html;
        }

        let slideInterval;
        function backToGov() {
            clearInterval(slideInterval);
            document.getElementById('detail-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('gov-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        function openPlace(placeName, fallbackImages, govKey) {
            document.getElementById('gov-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('detail-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('place-title').innerText = placeName;

            const driveFiles = govKey ? imagesForPlace(govKey, placeName) : [];
            const photoList = driveFiles.length
                ? driveFiles.map(file => ({ url: file.url, filename: file.name }))
                : (fallbackImages || []).map((url, i) => ({ url, filename: `Photo ${i + 1}` }));

            let sliderHtml = '';
            photoList.forEach((photo, index) => {
                const safeUrl = String(photo.url).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
                const safeFilename = String(photo.filename).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
                sliderHtml += `
                    <div class="mySlides" style="display: ${index === 0 ? 'block' : 'none'}">
                        <img src="${safeUrl}" alt="${safeFilename}" loading="lazy">
                        <div class="slide-caption">${safeFilename}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });
            if (!photoList.length) sliderHtml = '<p style="padding:24px;text-align:center">Photos will appear here when the Drive folder is connected.</p>';
            document.getElementById('slider-container').innerHTML = sliderHtml;

            let waText = encodeURIComponent(`Hello Gem Travel, I would like to inquire and reserve for: ${placeName}`);
            document.getElementById('wa-link').href = `https://wa.me/${primaryWhatsApp}?text=${waText}`;

            clearInterval(slideInterval);
            if (photoList.length > 1) {
                let sIndex = 0;
                slideInterval = setInterval(() => {
                    let slides = document.querySelectorAll('.mySlides');
                    slides.forEach(slide => slide.style.display = 'none');
                    sIndex = (sIndex + 1) % slides.length;
                    slides[sIndex].style.display = 'block';
                }, 3500);
            }
        }

        changeLanguage('en');
        loadDriveImages();
    </script>
</body>
